cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.description: Join thousands of taskees and taskers already using BitTasker

hero.title: The Decentralized Workforce.
hero.description: Hire professionals for any task. Pay with Bitcoin, Lightning, or USDT. Built on Nostr.

nostr.title: Powered by Nostr
nostr.description: BitTasker is built on Nostr, a decentralized protocol. This means your identity, data, and reputation are truly yours, free from corporate control and censorship.

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin Accepted
bitcoin.description: Embrace the future of money. Pay and get paid globally with Bitcoin, the world's most secure and decentralized digital currency, for borderless and low-cost transactions.

payments.title: Pay Your Way
payments.description: Buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer, or pay with Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning. Bitcoin from a card purchase is paid to your own address.

lightning.title: Lightning Network
lightning.description: Experience instant and near-free payments with the Lightning Network. Perfect for micro-payments, tipping, and settling tasks the moment they are completed.

escrow.title: Secure Payments
escrow.description: The hirer locks Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning in escrow. After they approve the work, they pay the worker's invoice. Nothing is paid on a timer.

step1.title: Post a Task
step1.description: Describe the work you need done, set your budget, and post it for our community.

step2.title: Hire the Best
step2.description: Review proposals from talented taskees and hire the perfect fit for your project.

step3.title: Pay Securely
step3.description: The hirer locks the amount in escrow before the work starts. After they approve the work, they pay the invoice. That usually takes a few minutes.

payments.title: Flexible Payments
payments.description: Pay with Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning. You can also buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer.

escrow.title: Non-Custodial Secure Payments
escrow.description: You open the wallet with your passkey. BitTasker cannot spend the escrow. You pay the invoice only after you approve the work.

ownership.title: True Data Ownership
ownership.description: Your identity, data, and reputation are yours to control, powered by Nostr's decentralized network.

fees.title: Lightning-Fast Payments
fees.description: After you approve the work, pay in Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning. BitTasker does not hold the money.

finalcta.title: Join the Future of Work
finalcta.description: Whether you need to hire talent or are looking for your next opportunity, BitTasker is the place to be.
